{{Quote|Hi, Dad. I'm back. Here's the evening faxsplat. By the way, feel free to ask me to run errands for you any time you want...|Prestor, son of a Hyperfoil owner|<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hyperfoil 1000-XTC''' was a VTOL (Vertical Take Off and Landing) [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] made for urban use by [[Tion Industries]].

==Characteristics==
A mixed-drive vehicle, the Hyperfoil combined [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive systems and [[hovercraft]] technology, creating a vehicle that was not only very attractive to collectors but also had a very high flight-ceiling for its price range. The hover engines were used for a quiet lift off and the repulsor engines kicked in for fast horizontal cruising flight.

==History==
Despite its advantages, the hybrid design never caught on. In spite of its reliability and ease of maintenance, the need to cram both hover and repulsor engines in the same chassis made the vehicle too big and cumbersome for optimal urban use.

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', the Hyperfoil 1000-XTC is 15 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, whereas ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' states that it is 7 meters long.
